claims.claim: a Mendelian randomization, colocalization and transcriptomic study proposes CXCR1 and CXCR2 as neutrophil extracellular trap-related treatment targets in UC
claims.quote: CXCR1 and CXCR2 are potential neutrophil extracellular trap-related treatment targets in ulcerative colitis: insights from Mendelian randomization, colocalization and transcriptomic analysis.
claims.reason: Title sentence of the cited paper says exactly this.

claims.claim: a separate eQTL/pQTL/transcriptome study ties the CXCL5/CXCR2 axis to neutrophil chemotaxis in UC
claims.quote: Enrichment and immune infiltration analysis indicated that the CXCL5/CXCR2 axis was involved in neutrophil chemotaxis and immune activation in UC.
claims.reason: Cited abstract states the axis involvement in neutrophil chemotaxis.

claims.claim: CXCR1 shares the genetic-colocalization paper that nominates CXCR1 and CXCR2 as neutrophil extracellular trap-related UC targets
claims.quote: CXCR1 and CXCR2 are potential neutrophil extracellular trap-related treatment targets in ulcerative colitis
claims.reason: Paper names both CXCR1 and CXCR2 as potential targets.

claims.claim: the CXCL8 axis with its receptors participates in UC pathogenesis through PI3K/Akt, MAPK and NF-kappaB signalling
claims.quote: The CXCL8-CXCR1/2 axis participates in the pathogenesis of UC through multiple signaling pathways, including PI3k/Akt, MAPKs and NF-kappaB signaling pathways.

claims.claim: In a blood RNA-seq validation set CXCL8 was among the best diagnostic genes for IBD, second to ITGA5
claims.quote: Validation with blood RNA-seq data (GSE169568, n = 205) showed ITGA5 (AUC: 0.856) and CXCL8 (AUC: 0.786) had the highest diagnostic performance.
claims.reason: ITGA5 AUC 0.856 first, CXCL8 0.786 second; subject-object is IBD.

claims.claim: IDO1 expression was elevated in UC patients and correlated with M1 macrophage polarization in both human data and colitis mice
claims.quote: The results indicated that IDO1 expression was significantly elevated in UC patients and correlated with M1 macrophage polarization observed in both human data and colitis mice.

claims.claim: IDO1 drove M1 polarization via the ER stress GRP78-XBP1 pathway
claims.quote: IDO1 induced macrophage M1 polarization via ER stress-associated GRP78-XBP1 pathway to promote ulcerative colitis progression.

claims.claim: An IDO1 inhibitor ameliorated DSS colitis in mice
claims.quote: Furthermore, 1-MT markedly ameliorated DSS-induced weight loss, colonic shortening and disease severity via inhibiting IDO1 expression level
claims.reason: 1-MT is an IDO1 inhibitor given to DSS mice.

claims.claim: All of this comes from one study
claims.reason: All three cited relations come from PMID 40370742.

claims.claim: IDO1 has the most mechanistic and interventional support among the targets
claims.reason: Comparison with other targets is not in the cited evidence.

claims.claim: MMP1 was reported as a diagnostic marker of UC-associated CRC with high AUC
claims.quote: MMP1 demonstrated strong diagnostic potential (AUC = 0.927, 95% CI = 0.895-0.959)

claims.claim: ilomastat was predicted in silico as an inhibitor
claims.quote: Drug prediction identified ilomastat as a potential MMP1 inhibitor with strong binding affinity (binding energy = -7.17 kcal/mol).

claims.claim: MMP1 transcripts modified by mirikizumab correlate with Mayo score, Geboes score and Robarts Histopathology Index
claims.quote: Transcripts significantly modified by mirikizumab correlate with key UC disease activity indices (modified Mayo score, Geboes Score, Robarts Histopathology Index) and include MMP1, MMP3, S100A8, and IL1B.

claims.claim: A hub-gene analysis also links MMP1 to macrophage infiltration
claims.quote: the hub genes CD274, MMP1, NCF2, and PLAU were positively associated with macrophage infiltration

claims.claim: CHI3L1 was significantly upregulated in UC patients and correlated with the NLRP3 inflammasome
claims.quote: CHI3L1 was significantly upregulated in UC patients and strongly correlated with NLR Family Pyrin Domain Containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome expression.

claims.claim: CHI3L1 promoted macrophage pyroptosis via a BCAT1/NF-kappaB axis
claims.quote: CHI3L1 promotes macrophage pyroptosis in ulcerative colitis via the BCAT1/NF-kappaB axis.

claims.claim: inhibiting CHI3L1 was protective
claims.quote: Both CHI3L1 knockdown and inhibitor treatment attenuated pyroptosis in vitro and ameliorated colitis in mice.

claims.claim: Velpatasvir binding to recombinant CHI3L1 was shown by microscale thermophoresis
claims.quote: We experimentally confirmed binding of velpatasvir to recombinant CHI3L1 using microscale thermophoresis

claims.claim: DUOX2 protein was among the most elevated in inflamed UC biopsies versus healthy controls, together with HLA-DRA, CD74 and LCN2
claims.quote: Proteins most highly elevated in inflamed UC biopsies relative to HC were those encoded by the HLA-DRA (P = 3.1 x 10-33) and CD74 (P = 1.6 x 10-27)
claims.reason: Sentence also lists DUOX2 and lipocalin-2.

claims.claim: Herbal formula TLXDS reduced UC by inhibiting DUOX2 overexpression
claims.quote: TLXDS alleviates UC by inhibiting DUOX2 overexpression, subsequently reducing inflammation and ferroptosis.

claims.claim: DUOX2 was proposed as a ferroptosis-linked candidate
claims.quote: Tuoli Xiaodu San Alleviates Ferroptosis in Ulcerative Colitis via Suppression of the DUOX2/GPX4 Axis.

claims.claim: DUOX2 was proposed as a diagnostic candidate
claims.quote: S100A8, IL-1B, CXCL1, TCN1, MMP10, GREM1, DUOX2 and SLC6A14 have been identified as credible potential biomarkers for the diagnosis and therapy of UC.

claims.claim: The evidence is preclinical

claims.claim: CXCL1 is repeatedly nominated as a diagnostic or activity marker across independent bioinformatic studies
claims.quote: S100A8, IL-1B, CXCL1, TCN1, MMP10, GREM1, DUOX2 and SLC6A14 have been identified as credible potential biomarkers for the diagnosis and therapy of UC.
